headline: Guinness-owner Diageo poaches P&G exec as City awaits turnaround plan
summary: The newly installed boss of Diageo has poached a senior Procter & Gamble (P&G) executive to join his leadership team, days before he unveils a revival plan for the maker of Guinness and Johnnie Walker.  Sky News has learnt that Sujay Wasan, the head of P&G's oral care business in North America, is joining the FTSE-100 alcoholic drinks company as the head of its Asia-Pacific operations.
